decision.explanation: The question asks what position Friedrich II. von Parsberg currently or formerly held. Two distinct historical figures named Friedrich II. von Parsberg are described in the provided documents. Document D1 refers to Friedrich II. von Parsberg (died 1461), who served as the diocesan bishop and specifically as the Bishop of Eichstätt. Document D2 refers to another Friedrich II. von Parsberg (1480–1543), who served as the Prince-Bishop of Augsburg and later as the Count of Astarac. All these positions are explicitly stated in the original sources and correspond to the requested relation. There is no contradiction between the two referents, and both sets of titles are valid and distinct.
